Legal & Policies

Welcome to English Vidya! We have explained our privacy policy and rules in simple language below.

We Respect Your Privacy!

Your personal data (like email or personal diary) is completely safe. We do not sell it to any 3rd-party company.

👤

What data do we collect?

  • Google Account Data: When you login with Google, we only take your Name, Email ID, and Profile Photo to create your account.
  • Public Data: The comments you make on the website, or the questions you ask in the forum, are public and everyone can see them.
  • Private Data: Your "Personal Notes" (diary) and "Bookmarks" are completely private. No other user can see them.
🛡️

What permissions do Admins have?

  • Our Admins can only see your public data (your comments, forum posts, and name).
  • No Admin or website owner can read your Personal Notes or Bookmarks. They are fully secure in the system.
  • Admins only work to protect the website from spam and maintain a healthy environment.
🗑️

Account Deletion

  • You can submit an account deletion request anytime by visiting Settings.
  • Upon deletion, your name, email, and photo will be completely erased from the system within 30 days.
  • Comments made by you will remain on the website (to help others), but your name will be removed from them (they will become Anonymous).

Community Rules

English Vidya is an educational platform. To keep it clean and focused, some strict rules have been made.

🚫

Strictly Prohibited

  • Abuse: Use of any kind of abusive language, swearing, or disrespectful remarks.
  • Religion & Politics: Commenting or making forum posts about any religion, god, politician, or political party (like BJP, Congress, etc.).
  • Spam: Sending meaningless messages, self-promotion, or advertising another product.
❤️

Respect & Love

  • Live with love, respect each other, and use this platform ONLY for the purpose of learning English.
  • If a user repeatedly violates the rules, their account features may be restricted to maintain a healthy learning environment.
🔗

Reference Links

  • If you provide a link to another website in the comments or forum, it will not go live immediately.
  • The link first goes into "Pending" mode. It will only be visible to others when our Admins check and approve it.
📚

1. Educational Purpose Only

  • All study material, dictionaries, and lessons available on English Vidya are for educational purposes only.
  • We do not give any legal guarantee of 100% success in any type of examination or job interview.
✏️

2. Accuracy & Errors

  • We have taken full care in compiling the 19,000+ words and grammar rules, yet human errors (Typing Mistakes) may occur.
  • Students are requested to cross-check facts once before important exams.

Last updated: June 2026
